reason: My guests ask the same three things, Wi-Fi, parking and the beach, and I already answer them on WhatsApp or leave a printed sheet in the apartment. With four apartments that is €140 a month plus setup for something I do myself for free.
objection: It is a monthly fee for every apartment, forever, and I don't need a machine to tell people the Wi-Fi password. If the guest has a real problem they will still message me anyway.
would_change_my_mind: One small yearly price for all my apartments together, only in the season, around €10 a month, with my nephew able to change the answers without calling anyone.
